sloka: व्यसने कच्चिदाढ्यस्य दुर्गतस्य च राघव ।अर्थं विरागा: पश्यन्ति तवामात्या बहुश्रुता: ॥ २.१००.५९॥
transliteration: vyasane kaccidāḍhyasya durgatasya ca rāghava ।arthaṁ virāgā: paśyanti tavāmātyā bahuśrutā: ॥ 2.100.59॥

translations.english: O Bharata, the tears falling from the eyes of persons, who are falsely accused and punished for the pleasure of the king will destroy his progeny and cattle as well.
